deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep com.digitalpetri.modbus/modbus-tcp, dep org.eclipse.milo/sdk-server, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint, alias :opcua-verify): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.
